source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Model Robustness and Reliability' under topic 6.8 (PDF 87, printed 83).

blocks.text: Robustness (mazbooti) ka matlab hai model mukhtalif halaat mein achha chale. Reliable (qabil-e-bharosa) model har dafa ek jaise results deta hai. Robust models data ke noise (shor, yani faltu ya ghalat values) ko sambhal lete hain aur chhoti tabdeeliyon se fail nahi hote. Asal duniya mein istemal ke liye reliability zaroori hai. Mukhtalif halaat mein testing se robustness jaanchi jati hai. Mazboot models apni accuracy barqarar rakhte hain, reliability systems par bharosa banati hai, aur robust models zyada kaam ke hote hain.
